'''Tim Guzman''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 117 from Las Vegas, Nv. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He became a tournament director in Las Vegas after playing in events run by Chris Hines (Gold 8), and joined the squadron on Hines's recommendation.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
